title: This startup wants CFOs to treat cloud bills as innovation funds
summary: Cloud Lens AI is a new application that uses artificial intelligence to analyze AWS cloud bills, identify wasted spending, and suggest reallocating those funds for AI projects.

title: In a sea of generic AI writing, a smart brand would let humans write - South China Morning Post
summary: The article argues that in an era of generic AI-generated content, discerning brands should emphasize human writing to distinguish themselves.

title: DeepSeek may file mainland IPO application this year
summary: Chinese AI model developer DeepSeek is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) on a mainland stock exchange, with a potential listing application this year and a target debut in 2027.

title: Australia Plans Copyright Protections, Energy Rules in AI Policy - Bloomberg.com
summary: Australia is planning to introduce new policies regarding artificial intelligence, including measures for copyright protection and energy consumption rules.

title: US Firms Shift to Chinese AI Despite Verified Data Transfer Violations - SOFX
summary: Despite verified data transfer violations, some US firms are reportedly opting to use Chinese artificial intelligence technologies.

title: In-Context Reinforcement Learning under Non-Stationarity: A Survey
summary: This paper surveys the renewed interest in in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL), exploring its ability for pretrained or fine-tuned decision models to infer task rules, driven by advancements in areas like decision transformers and retrieval-augmented agents.

title: Ontology-Amplified Distillation and Contextuality Auditing for Sovereign Enterprise Language Models: A Combined Proof-of-Mechanism and Negative-Results Method Study
summary: This paper presents a combined study on ontology-amplified distillation and contextuality auditing for sovereign enterprise language models, focusing on methods for financial institutions under data-residency rules.

title: GRID: Grammar-Railed Decoding for Enterprise SQL Generation
summary: This paper introduces GRID (Grammar-Railed Decoding), a method to ensure large language models generate syntactically valid and policy-compliant SQL for enterprise applications, addressing challenges beyond just plausible text.

title: Calibration-First Reward-Component Auditing for Reinforcement Learning Control in Smart Greenhouses
summary: This research paper proposes a "calibration-first reward-component auditing" method for reinforcement learning control in smart greenhouses, aimed at improving transparency and understanding of AI policies for climate control.

title: Optimization Is Not All You Need
summary: This article critiques the prevailing "optimization culture" in artificial intelligence development, using OpenAI's GPT-2 and its alignment process as an example to question whether optimization is the sole necessary goal.

title: Designing Agent-Ready Websites for AI Web Agents: A Framework for Machine Readability, Actionability, and Decision Reliability
summary: This paper introduces a framework for designing "agent-ready" websites, emphasizing machine readability, actionability, and decision reliability to facilitate independent operations by AI web agents in tasks like online shopping.

title: Graph Feedback Controls Consensus and Clique Formation in Open-Weight Language-Model Populations
summary: This research investigates how graph feedback influences consensus and clique formation within populations of open-weight language models operating in multi-agent systems.

title: Operationalising Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Conversational Agents: A Scalable, Governed Pipeline with Selective Re-evaluation and Model Benchmarking
summary: This paper proposes a scalable, multi-dimensional evaluation pipeline for retail conversational agents, using methods like LLM-as-a-judge to assess intent, factuality, helpfulness, and overall response quality beyond traditional metrics.

title: The Emerging Paradigm of Geospatial Foundation Models: From Pre-Training to Agentic Reasoning
summary: This paper introduces the emerging paradigm of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs), describing them as AI/ML models pre-trained on large geospatial datasets for analyzing satellite and aerial imagery, and discusses their capabilities including agentic reasoning.

title: Cost-Governed RAG: Unified Per-Tenant Cost Attribution Across Retrieval and Generation in Multi-Tenant LLM Systems
summary: This paper introduces "Cost-Governed RAG," a framework for unified per-tenant cost attribution across both retrieval and generation components in multi-tenant LLM systems, addressing the unmetered costs of the retrieval layer including vector memory and embeddings.

title: A Threshold Exceedance Framework for CBRN Uplift Evaluation in Frontier Language Models
summary: This paper proposes a "Threshold Exceedance Framework" for evaluating the potential "CBRN uplift" in frontier language models, aiming to assess how access to these models might increase a non-expert's ability to plan chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear misuse.

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
summary: This paper re-evaluates the methodology of automatic "harness evolution" for LLM agents, critically examining how existing methods use unit test cases and public benchmarks to assess performance.

title: How Many Tasks Are Enough for Agent Benchmark Decisions? A Replay Analysis of Public LLM Agent Benchmarks
summary: This paper analyzes how many tasks are sufficient for reliable conclusions in agent benchmarks, studying whether partial runs support the same results as completed ones.

title: PM-Bench: Evaluating Prospective Memory in LLM Agents
summary: This introduces PM-Bench, a new text-based benchmark designed to evaluate the prospective memory capabilities of LLM agents.

title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: This paper proposes a 'Critic Experience Bank' for LLM agents to enable self-evolving step-level confidence estimation, improving reliability and preventing costly errors.

title: Isolation as a First-Class Principle for LLM-Agent System Safety: Concepts, Taxonomy, Challenges and Future Directions
summary: This paper discusses 'Isolation' as a primary principle for LLM-agent system safety, outlining concepts, challenges, and future directions for ensuring secure and reliable agent behavior.

title: Accepted Prefixes Are Not All You Need: A Negative Result on PEFT-Based Block-Diffusion Drafting
summary: This research analyzes a negative result concerning PEFT-based block-diffusion drafting for speculative decoding, evaluating its effectiveness in accelerating autoregressive language model inference and improving draft quality.

title: EVOQUANT: Self-Evolving Verifier-Guided Strategy Optimization for Robust Quantitative Trading
summary: This paper introduces EVOQUANT, a system that uses large language models for self-evolving, verifier-guided optimization of robust quantitative trading strategies, automating a largely manual process.

title: Do We Really Need Transformers for Global Spatial Information Extraction in Traffic Forecasting?
summary: This research investigates the necessity of Transformer models for global spatial information extraction in traffic forecasting, questioning current model design paradigms.

title: Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle as Mid-Training for Coding Agent Foundation Models
summary: This paper proposes 'Function-Aware Fill-in-the-Middle' as a mid-training method for coding agent foundation models to improve their ability to integrate external tool returns into ongoing reasoning.

title: From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery
summary: This paper explores the concept of 'Mechanistic World Models' and their role in autonomous scientific discovery, emphasizing understanding over mere prediction in the context of foundation models.

title: TRACE: An Operational Reasoning Schema for Auditable Agentic Commitments
summary: This paper defines TRACE, an operational reasoning schema for recording auditable reasoning traces in agentic systems, ensuring transparency and accountability for commitments.

title: The Model Knows Your Project, Not You: Measuring Recognition in LLMs with NameRank
summary: This paper introduces NameRank, a method to measure an LLM's intrinsic recognition of entities, assessing what a frontier model recalls about a person or tool from its own weights.

title: Evidence-Grounded AI for Musculoskeletal Care
summary: This paper advocates for Evidence-Grounded AI in musculoskeletal care, highlighting its potential for longitudinal management and integration of evolving data to improve patient outcomes.

title: Vertical Standardisation for High-Risk AI Systems under the EU AI Act: A Domain-Specific Framework for Algorithmic Hiring
summary: This paper proposes a domain-specific framework for vertical standardization of high-risk AI systems, specifically algorithmic hiring, to ensure compliance with the EU AI Act requirements.

title: Agentic Service-Oriented Computing: A Manifesto for the Next Frontier of Service-Oriented Computing
summary: This manifesto introduces 'Agentic Service-Oriented Computing,' defining a new paradigm where LLM-powered agents transform software systems into goal-directed, adaptive, and tool-using computational actors.

title: Atomic Units of X: The Compression Layer of Intelligence
summary: This paper proposes a theoretical framework for intelligence based on 'atomic compression and compositional reuse,' applicable to cognitive, biological, computational, and organizational systems.

title: A Learning-Rate-Gated Failure of GRPO in a Small Language and Vision-Language Model Web Agent: A Controlled Null and Its Mechanism
summary: This research identifies and analyzes a learning-rate-gated failure mechanism within Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) when applied to small language and vision-language model web agents.

title: Internet of Agentic Things: Networked AI Agents for Closed-Loop IoT Orchestration
summary: This paper introduces the 'Internet of Agentic Things' (IoAT), an architectural framework integrating agentic AI, IoT, and other technologies for closed-loop orchestration of cyber-physical systems.

title: MaxSAT-Based Feedback for Guiding Vision-Language Models in Sudoku
summary: This paper proposes MaxSAT-Based Feedback to guide Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in enforcing logical consistency for structured visual reasoning tasks like Sudoku, improving their accuracy.

title: LLMs Can See the Smoke but not the Fire: Evaluating Abductive Reasoning with Elenchos
summary: This paper introduces Elenchos, a method for evaluating the abductive reasoning capabilities of large language models, assessing their ability to infer latent hypotheses from observed behavior.

title: Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success
summary: This paper addresses failure attribution in LLM-based agentic systems, proposing methods to identify the specific steps that cause task failures for effective debugging and improvement.

title: Do We Really Need Multimodal Emotion Language Models Larger Than 1B Parameters?
summary: This research explores the necessity of large multimodal emotion language models (MLLMs) over 1 billion parameters for multimodal emotion recognition, analyzing their performance improvements and interpretability.

title: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: This paper proposes a method for co-evolving evaluation metrics and skills to enable self-improving LLM agents, addressing the challenge of reliable evaluation in agentic systems.

title: Visual Access Boundaries in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary: This study investigates the reasoning process in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, specifically whether it requires continuous access to image tokens.

title: Human-AI Agent Interaction as a Neuroplastic Training Environment
summary: This item describes human interaction with AI agents, such as assistants and coding copilots, as a neuroplastic training environment for iterative feedback loops.

title: Solution of the Hempel's statistical ambiguity problem and Causal AI
summary: This paper presents a solution to Carl Hempel's statistical ambiguity problem in inductive-statistical inference by applying Causal AI methods to avoid contradictory predictions.

title: A Multi-Agent System for Autonomous, Fine-Tuning-Free Clinical Symptom Detection: Development and Validation Study
summary: This study details the development and validation of a multi-agent system designed for autonomous, fine-tuning-free clinical symptom detection from clinical notes.

title: MemOps: Benchmarking Lifecycle Memory Operations in Long-Horizon Conversations
summary: This research introduces MemOps, a new benchmark for evaluating lifecycle memory operations in LLM-based agents during long-horizon, multi-session conversations, beyond simple question answering.

title: Knowledge- and Gradient-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Parametrized Action Markov Decision Processes
summary: This paper studies Reinforcement Learning in Parametrized Action Markov Decision Processes (PAMDP), proposing knowledge- and gradient-guided approaches to determine symbolic actions and numerical parameters.

title: FormalAnalyticGeo: A Neural-Symbolic Based Framework for Multimodal Analytic Geometry Problem Generation
summary: This item introduces FormalAnalyticGeo, a neural-symbolic framework for generating multimodal analytic geometry problems to advance math reasoning with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

title: Resist and Update: Counterfactual Report Coordinates for Incentive-Compatible LLMs
summary: This paper addresses the issue of aligned language models misreporting under incentive pressure, casting it as a failure of internal incentive-compatibility and proposing a method for learning and certifying trustworthiness.

title: Win by Silence: Deletion Non-Monotonicity, Autonomous Exploitation, and Typed-State Gating in LLM Plan Evaluation
summary: This paper analyzes a failure mode in LLM plan evaluation where strategic plans are rewarded for becoming less explicit, studying deletion non-monotonicity in venture route scoring.

title: Audio-Native Speech Recognition with a Frozen Discrete-Diffusion Language Model
summary: This research explores using a frozen discrete-diffusion language model for audio-native automatic speech recognition, refining full transcripts in parallel rather than token-by-token.

title: Do AI Agents Know When a Task Is Simple? Toward Complexity-Aware Reasoning and Execution
summary: This paper investigates whether AI agents possess complexity-aware reasoning, addressing how LLM agents can improve multi-step workflows by assessing task effort rather than using a maximum-context strategy.

title: Answering Without Referring: How AI Search Rewrites the Web's Economic Bargain
summary: This paper analyzes how AI search, exemplified by ChatGPT and Google, changes the web's economic model by resolving information needs within the intermediary instead of routing users to websites.

title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
summary: This paper introduces FAIR GraphRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach that enhances LLM responses for semantic data analysis by using graph-based methods to capture relationships within knowledge graphs.

title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models
summary: This research addresses lookahead bias in large language models by introducing 'point-in-time language models,' which are trained exclusively on historical text to ensure valid backtests and causal inference in finance and social sciences.

title: So Many Opinions, So Many LLMs: Comparing Large Language Models to Traditional Machine Learning for Open- Ended Survey Analysis
summary: This study compares Large Language Models (LLMs) to traditional machine learning methods for analyzing open-ended survey data, aiming to improve scalability and insights from survey responses.

title: CANDI: Contextual Alignment for Niche Domains Question Answering
summary: This research introduces CANDI, a framework for evaluating the contextual alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for question answering in niche domains like medical diagnostics and financial advisory.

title: G-SHARE: A Guideline-Based Structured Reasoning Framework for Human-Factor Event Diagnosis
summary: This paper proposes G-SHARE, a guideline-based structured reasoning framework for human-factor event diagnosis in nuclear power plants, addressing the limitations of existing data-driven and one-shot LLM approaches.

title: I'm Sorry, but I Can't Help with Braille: Revealing Accessibility Failures in State-of-the-Art LLMs
summary: This research reveals accessibility failures in state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) by evaluating their capability in structurally constrained, accessibility-critical modalities like Korean-Braille translation.

title: OmniPMNet: Bridging discrete and gridded PM10 forecasts via omni-query neural processes
summary: OmniPMNet is a neural network designed for forecasting PM10 particulate matter, bridging discrete station-scale accuracy and continuous spatial fields, especially during dust storms.

title: Semidirect Fourier Delta Attention: Phase-Controlled Delta Memory with Constructive Chunk-WY Kernels
summary: Semidirect Fourier Delta Attention (SFDA) is a new attention mechanism that improves long-context memory by replacing softmax attention's KV cache with a phase-controlled recurrent state.

title: Repairing Shape-Prior Shortcuts in Long-Range Single-Shot Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: This research addresses a problem in single-shot fringe projection profilometry (FPP) where neural networks exploit shape-prior shortcuts, recovering depth from object boundaries rather than fringe phase.

title: Mirror Horizon: Viable Path Entropy as a Measure of Bounded Reflection
summary: Mirror Theory proposes using viable path entropy (VPE) to measure how intelligent systems sustain coherent continuations under repeated reflection, contributing to the philosophical understanding of AI.

title: CARE-LoRA: Compressed Activation REconstruction for Memory-Efficient LoRA
summary: CARE-LoRA is a new method for Compressed Activation Reconstruction designed to make LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) more memory-efficient when fine-tuning large pre-trained models under limited memory budgets.

title: BattVAE-GP: Generative Modeling of Long-Horizon Battery Degradation with Uncertainty Quantification
summary: BattVAE-GP is a hybrid physics-probabilistic learning framework for generative modeling of long-horizon battery degradation, offering uncertainty quantification and a surrogate for expensive simulations.

title: Scale-Aware Attention for Scarce Neural Data: An RG-Flow Transformer on Sleep-EDF EEG
summary: This research introduces a Scale-Aware Attention mechanism using an RG-Flow Transformer to analyze sleep-EDF EEG data, aiming to track cortical states and sleep depth based on brain field potentials.

title: Scalable Optimal Transport Algorithm for Network Alignment
summary: This paper presents a scalable optimal transport algorithm designed for network alignment, a fundamental problem in data science for identifying node correspondences across different networks.

title: Graph-Constrained Policy Learning for Extreme Clinical Code Prediction
summary: This research proposes Graph-Constrained Policy Learning for extreme clinical code prediction, a method to map unstructured discharge summaries to hierarchical ICD-10-CM codes, addressing challenges of sparse and rare labels.

title: Constructed Reality, Contested Priors: Decoupling and the Architecture of Cognitive Relapse Under the Free Energy Principle
summary: This paper explores how predictive systems under the Free Energy Principle maintain generative models of reality, discussing the architecture of cognitive relapse and the consistency required for AI inference machinery in synthetic environments.

title: Evaluating Reliability in Machine Learning Models for Early Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction: A Systematic Review of Data Leakage and Predictor Stability
summary: This systematic review evaluates the reliability of machine learning models for early Chronic Kidney Disease prediction, focusing on common issues like data leakage and predictor stability in reported studies.

title: LIDAR-AD: A Decoder-Free Latent-Interaction Dreamer with Action-Residual Chains for Autonomous Driving
summary: LIDAR-AD is a decoder-free latent-interaction model with action-residual chains designed for autonomous driving, enabling long-horizon closed-loop decision making in dynamic traffic environments.

title: Beyond Coordinate Gauge: An Audited Protocol for Detecting Donor-Specific Functional Fingerprints after Neural Collapse
summary: This research proposes an audited protocol to detect donor-specific functional fingerprints in independently trained neural networks after neural collapse, addressing the challenge of comparing network states due to coordinate freedom.

title: Self-Evolving In-Context Learning for Direct Pilot-to-Beamformer Design in MU-MISO Systems
summary: This paper develops a self-evolving in-context learning (ICL) framework to improve pilot-based beamformer design in multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) systems, integrating an ICL-Transformer backbone.

title: Learning to Discretize: Diffusion-Based Adaptive Mesh with Spectral Guidance
summary: This research introduces 'Learning to Discretize,' a method utilizing diffusion-based adaptive mesh with spectral guidance to improve neural partial differential equation (PDE) surrogates by optimizing grid selection.

title: LiteTopK: Exploiting the Curse of Dimensionality for a Fused Indexer-TopK Kernel in Long-Context Sparse Attention
summary: LiteTopK is a fused Indexer-TopK kernel designed to optimize long-context sparse attention in large language models and vector databases by exploiting the curse of dimensionality, improving retrieval efficiency.

title: Gene Expression-Informed Jointly Controlled Generative Modeling for Precision Molecular Design
summary: This research presents Gene Expression-Informed Jointly Controlled Generative Modeling, a method for precision molecular design aimed at discovering personalized drug candidates through multi-conditional control.

title: Sparse Inter-Layer Dependencies of Transformer FFN Neurons
summary: This research examines the sparse inter-layer dependencies of Feedforward Network (FFN) neurons within Transformer architectures, aiming to understand their internal structure and interpretability despite complex additive superposition.

title: Mitigating The Effect of Class Imbalance in Data with Hierarchical and Dependable Structure
summary: This research explores methods to mitigate class imbalance in hierarchically structured data, specifically addressing the challenging task of classifying cybersecurity vulnerabilities using the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) taxonomy.

title: Are we Merging the Right Models? Impact of Expert Training Duration on Model Merging for LLMs
summary: This research investigates the impact of training duration on expert models when merging them into a single Large Language Model (LLM), challenging standard merging conventions to optimize multi-task performance.

title: Institutional Equity Holdings Prediction Using Node Affinities of Dynamic Graphs
summary: This paper presents a method using node affinities of dynamic graphs to predict institutional equity holdings based on SEC Form 13F filings, addressing challenges in forecasting investment manager portfolio decisions.

title: Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: This research explores the use of Sparse Autoencoders for interpretable Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection, aiming to improve the reliability and safety of machine learning models by identifying inputs that deviate from training data.

title: PFAdapter: Hierarchical LoRA Decomposition for Personalized Federated MLLMs
summary: PFAdapter is introduced as a hierarchical LoRA decomposition method for personalized federated Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), designed to enable collaborative learning in agentic AI systems while maintaining data privacy.

title: Continual Learning with Elastic Regularization and Synthetic Replay for Federated MLLM Fine-Tuning
summary: This paper proposes a continual learning approach using elastic regularization and synthetic replay for federated fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), addressing catastrophic forgetting in distributed network environments.

title: An Agentic AI Scientific Community for Automated Neural Operator Discovery
summary: This work presents an agentic AI scientific community for automated neural operator discovery, comprising a swarm of virtual laboratories that interact and evolve based on a citation-based economy of influence.

title: From Geometric Recovery to Causal Validation: A Reproducible Audit of Sparse Autoencoder Features, from Superposition Geometry to Causal Inertness
summary: This research provides a reproducible audit of Sparse Autoencoder features, moving from geometric recovery to causal validation, to better understand how these models decompose neural representations into interpretable components.

title: Forgetful Attention: A Trainable Support-Vector Memory with Certified Selection and Exact Unlearning
summary: Forgetful Attention is introduced as a trainable support-vector memory mechanism for attention, offering certified selection and exact unlearning capabilities in an online learning context.

title: Speculate with Memory: Lossless Acceleration for LLM Agents
summary: This paper proposes using memory to accelerate LLM agents by making speculative execution stateful, allowing prediction quality to improve with experience and overcome the limitations of stateless speculators.

title: Proximity Features: Privacy-Compliant Cold-Start Personalization at Airbnb
summary: This work describes 'Proximity Features,' a privacy-compliant method for cold-start personalization at Airbnb, designed to provide effective recommendations for users with limited interaction history in two-sided marketplaces.

title: Understanding Structured Health Data through Interaction-Aware Mixture-of-Experts
summary: This study applies interaction-aware mixture-of-experts to structured health data for post-stroke rigidity prediction, revealing insights into feature importance for interpretability despite minimal performance gains.

title: From Many to Meaningful: Feature-Guided Zero-Shot Chronic Kidney Disease Screening Using Large Language Models
summary: This research explores feature-guided zero-shot chronic kidney disease screening using Large Language Models, aiming to enable early detection in resource-limited settings without reliance on large labeled datasets.

title: Track, Rank, Crack: Epistemic Working Memory Scales Multi-Hop Reasoning in Language Agents
summary: This paper demonstrates that 'Epistemic Working Memory' can scale multi-hop reasoning in language agents, addressing the degradation of performance as reasoning chains lengthen due to context dilution.

title: Quantum Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks: Learning Conservative and Dissipative Dynamics via Measurement-Induced Nonlinearity
summary: Quantum Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks (Q-pHNNs) are introduced as a family of parameterized quantum circuits that learn classical dynamics in a structure-preserving manner through measurement-induced nonlinearity.

title: A hybrid analytical-PINN model for subsurface simulation of geothermal heat exchangers in heterogeneous underground
summary: This paper develops a hybrid analytical-Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) model for subsurface simulation of geothermal heat exchangers in heterogeneous underground, effectively handling singularities and complex thermal problems.

title: Generating Developable 3D Molecules via Pocket-Conditioned Diffusion and Property-Aware Optimization
summary: This research proposes a method for generating developable 3D molecules using pocket-conditioned diffusion models and property-aware optimization, aimed at accelerating de novo drug design within the structure-based drug design paradigm.

title: SinAE: A Single-Architecture Flow-Matching Autoencoder for Cross-Domain Atomic Systems
summary: SinAE is presented as a single-architecture flow-matching autoencoder designed for cross-domain atomic systems, enabling unified generative pipelines for small molecules, crystals, and proteins.

title: Differentiable Clone-Structured Causal Graphs for End-to-End Cognitive Map Learning from Image Sequences
summary: This paper introduces Differentiable Clone-Structured Causal Graphs for end-to-end cognitive map learning from image sequences, providing a normative hippocampus model for agents to build structured world representations from raw sensory input.

title: ReDiTT: Retrieval Augmented Conditional Diffusion Transformers for Asynchronous Time Series
summary: ReDiTT is introduced as a retrieval-augmented conditional diffusion transformer model for asynchronous time series prediction, aiming to predict future inter-event times and event types while addressing inherent uncertainty.

title: Mechanical Analysis of Parachute Suspension Line Deployment with Binding Tapes Using PINN
summary: This research utilizes Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN) for the mechanical analysis of parachute suspension line deployment with binding tapes, studying the intricate dynamics of this critical ultra-short process.

title: PolarBM: Complex-valued Boltzmann Machine for Modeling Audio Signals in Polar and Log-polar Coordinates
summary: This item introduces PolarBM, a complex-valued Boltzmann Machine designed for modeling audio signals using polar and log-polar coordinates, addressing limitations of conventional real-valued machine learning methods.

title: Fisher Rank Inflation: A Spectral Signature of Memorization under Label Noise
summary: This research reveals that deep networks trained with label noise exhibit a spectral signature in last-layer gradients, indicating a transient expansion and contraction of effective rank during memorization of corrupted labels.

title: The Computational Basis of Confidence in Large Language Models
summary: This research investigates the fundamental computational basis of confidence in Large Language Models, aiming to understand how well their self-reported certainty predicts correctness and calibration.

title: Exploring Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: This paper explores the use of zero-shot Foundation Models for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection (MTSAD), addressing the cost and scalability limitations of conventional application-specific models in domains like industrial monitoring.

title: Sample Efficient Generative Optimization for Molecular Design
summary: This research focuses on sample-efficient generative optimization for molecular design, aiming to accelerate drug discovery and materials design by searching vast chemical spaces with limited costly evaluations.

title: Adversarial Attacks on Online Handwriting using Salience-based Temporal Editing
summary: This research investigates adversarial attacks on deep learning models used for online handwriting recognition, proposing salience-based temporal editing methods to challenge their vulnerability.

title: What Does Goodness Measure? A Likelihood-Ratio Account of Forward-Forward Learning
summary: This paper provides a likelihood-ratio account of the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm, explaining how it trains each layer locally based on a scalar goodness measure and normalized activations.

title: OOD-RL-Bench: A Benchmark Framework for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
summary: This item introduces OOD-RL-Bench, a benchmark framework designed for evaluating out-of-distribution detection capabilities in reinforcement learning agents to ensure operational integrity amidst environmental changes.

title: From Preimage Search To Source-Grounded Feature Inversion
summary: This research explores methods for interpreting neural networks by developing techniques for feature inversion, aiming to express selected internal features in the input domain beyond canonical iterative approaches.

title: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng becomes world's richest AI founder as net worth tops … - The Times of India
summary: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng has reportedly become the world's wealthiest AI founder, with his net worth topping a significant figure.

title: Graph-Based Detection of Disinformation Narrative Diffusion between Russian and Ukrainian Telegram Channels
summary: This research proposes a graph-based framework to detect and analyze the diffusion of disinformation narratives across Russian and Ukrainian Telegram channels, addressing challenges of scale, evolution, and linguistic variability.

title: TAKE: Trajectory-Aware Knowledge Estimation for Text Dataset Distillation
summary: This paper introduces TAKE, a trajectory-aware knowledge estimation framework for text dataset distillation, which reduces large text corpora to a fraction of their size while preserving performance for NLP tasks.

title: Transforming LLMs into Efficient Cross-Encoders via Knowledge Distillation for RAG Reranking
summary: This research demonstrates a method for transforming LLMs into efficient cross-encoders using knowledge distillation, thereby reducing quadratic inference costs for RAG reranking and improving real-time deployment.

title: MAGE: Understanding Stability-Performance Trade-offs in Multi-component Prompt Optimization
summary: This item introduces MAGE (Memory-Augmented Goal-directed Prompt Evolution), a controlled analysis framework for investigating the interaction and trade-offs between stability and performance in multi-component prompt optimization.

title: Belief-reality separation lives in routing over a shared value slot in language models
summary: This research investigates the computational mechanisms within language models that enable the separation of belief from reality, suggesting it involves routing over a shared value slot.

title: Hybrid Continual Learning for Low-Resource Australian Aboriginal Language Identification
summary: This research explores hybrid continual learning approaches for identifying low-resource Australian Aboriginal languages, aiming to improve speech technologies despite extreme data scarcity through transfer learning.

title: Evaluating Nonuniform Dependability Across Response Conditions: A Conditional Generalizability Framework Illustrated in Automated Essay Scoring
summary: This study introduces a conditional generalizability framework to evaluate nonuniform dependability across response conditions, illustrated through its application in automated essay scoring.

title: Agentic systems for breast cancer treatment recommendations
summary: This research evaluates agentic Large Language Model systems for generating breast cancer treatment recommendations using 72 real clinical cases, exploring their reliability in complex oncology decision support.

title: Beyond Parallel Tracking: Interactive Multi-Feature Fusion Drives Semantic Reconstruction from Non-invasive Brain Recordings
summary: This research explores interactive multi-feature fusion to drive semantic reconstruction from non-invasive brain recordings, aiming to overcome representational mismatches between neural signals and semantic feature spaces.

title: The Capacity of Thought: Benchmarking Llama 3.2 in Semantic fMRI Neural Language Decoding and Improving the Huth Encoding-Model Baseline
summary: This paper benchmarks Llama 3.2's performance in decoding continuous language from fMRI signals. It also presents improvements to an existing ridge regression encoding pipeline for fMRI data.

title: CityBehavEx: A Scalable and Empirically Validated LLM-Assisted Urban Simulation Platform
summary: CityBehavEx is presented as a scalable and empirically validated LLM-assisted urban simulation platform. It improves upon existing LLM-based multi-agent urban simulators by addressing cost and validation against real mobility patterns.

title: Token Reduction Is Not Cost Reduction
summary: This work investigates when reducing retrieved context or tool output for API-based coding agents actually lowers the billed cost. It examines context-reduction layers, including compressors, retrieval rankers, and payload optimizers.

title: We Hebben Een Serieus Translatie: Modeling Intercomprehension as Probabilistic Inference
summary: This research models intercomprehension, the partial intelligibility between related languages, as probabilistic inference. It extends algorithmic models of noisy-channel inference to explain zero-shot cross-language comprehension.

title: Comparing Semantic Navigation in Humans and Large Language Models using Natural Language Processing
summary: This research compares semantic search dynamics and navigation patterns between humans and three large language models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-Sonnet-4.5). It uses verbal fluency data and trajectory-based NLP metrics for the comparison.

title: Fine-Tuned Multi-Agent Framework for Detecting OCEAN in Life Narratives
summary: This paper presents a fine-tuned multi-agent framework designed for accurately detecting OCEAN personality traits from life narratives. It leverages large language models to process extensive textual contexts for this challenging task.

title: RCWT: Measuring Task-Budget Displacement from Coordination Content in LLM Calls
summary: This work introduces RCWT, a method for measuring task-budget displacement caused by coordination content within LLM calls in multi-agent and memory-augmented systems. It addresses the practical problem of token allocation in finite prompts.

title: Fin-Analyst at FinMMEval 2026 Task 3: A Live Hybrid Trading Agent with LLM Specialists and Rule-Based Signals
summary: This paper presents Fin-Analyst, a live hybrid trading agent designed for FinMMEval 2026 Task 3. It utilizes an eight-specialist LLM pipeline combined with rule-based signals for financial analysis.

title: FinResearchBench II: A Deep Research Benchmark with Consensus-Derived Gold Rubrics for Distinguishing Financial Report Quality
summary: This paper introduces FinResearchBench II, a deep research benchmark designed to evaluate the quality of financial reports produced by AI agents. It proposes a scalable pipeline for generating high-quality, consensus-derived gold rubrics.

title: A Shared Subcircuit Lets LLMs Count Down Across Tasks
summary: This research identifies a shared subcircuit within the Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct model that allows it to perform countdown-related tasks. This mechanism enables LLMs to track token counts and remaining elements across various tasks.

title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
summary: This paper introduces LakeQuest, a three-domain benchmark for grounded question answering systems operating over diverse data lakes. It addresses the challenge of navigating heterogeneous and weakly structured data collections in real-world scenarios.

title: QUBO-Optimized Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering with Unconventional Solvers
summary: This research proposes using QUBO-optimized evidence selection for Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering (RAG) with unconventional solvers. It aims to improve how RAG pipelines select complementary passages, moving beyond simple top-k ranking for multi-hop questions.

title: Evaluating Health Misinformation in Low-Resource Languages: Integrating Small Language Models with a Culturally-Sensitive Responsible NLP Framework (Bangla as a Case Study)
summary: This research focuses on evaluating health misinformation in low-resource languages, using Bangla as a case study. It integrates small language models with a culturally-sensitive Responsible NLP Framework to address this challenge.

title: Policy-Conditioned Constrained Decoding for Column-Level Access Control in Text-to-SQL
summary: This research proposes policy-conditioned constrained decoding to implement column-level access control in Text-to-SQL systems. It aims to balance policy compliance, answer coverage, and bounded cost when deploying AI across trust boundaries.

title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
summary: This research introduces Ring-Zero, a method for scaling "zero RL" (Reinforcement Learning with verifiable rewards) to trillion-parameter models. The goal is to achieve emergent reasoning without relying on human-annotated data.

title: WikiSTAR: A System for Shedding Light on the Hidden History of Scientific Wikipedia Articles
summary: WikiSTAR is a system developed to uncover the hidden history of scientific Wikipedia articles by highlighting scientifically meaningful revisions. It analyzes the extensive revision history of articles to reveal how scientific knowledge evolves.

title: Language Identification with Succinct Machine-Independent Traces
summary: This research explores language identification using succinct machine-independent traces, reinvigorated by large language models. It investigates variants of the Gold-Angluin model to overcome limitations in its original formulation.

title: Translation as a Computationally Efficient Bridge: Feasibility of English BERT for Low-Resource Languages
summary: This research investigates the feasibility of using English BERT models for low-resource languages by leveraging translation as a computationally efficient bridge. It aims to address challenges in developing high-quality BERT models for non-English languages.

title: KnowAct-GUIClaw: Know Deeply, Act Perfectly, Personal GUI Assistant with Self-Evolving Memory and Skill
summary: This paper introduces KnowAct-GUIClaw, a personal GUI assistant built on the OpenClaw framework, which addresses limitations in cross-platform GUI interaction and self-evolution mechanisms for complex task automation. It aims to improve adaptability and performance across diverse device ecosystems.

title: Can Induced Emotion Bias LLM Behaviors in Sequential Decision Making?
summary: This research investigates whether induced emotions can bias the sequential decision-making behaviors of Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly when deployed as autonomous agents in high-stakes domains. It explores how contextual emotional factors might modulate LLM decision processes.

title: Segregate, Refine, Integrate: Decomposing Multimodal Fusion for Sentiment Analysis
summary: This paper proposes SeRIn, a multimodal language model fusion scheme that segregates, refines, and integrates modality-specific signals for sentiment analysis. It aims to better handle the competing objectives of refining individual signals and modeling cross-modal interactions.

title: From Critic to Confidence: PPO for Language-Based Quantitative Prediction with Confidence Estimation
summary: This paper introduces CARE-PPO, a reinforcement learning framework designed to improve language-based quantitative prediction in LLMs by estimating prediction confidence and mitigating hallucinations. It aims to enhance trustworthiness by indicating when model predictions can be relied upon.

title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
summary: This research proposes a cost-aware speculative decoding method to improve the inference efficiency of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models. The method aims to accelerate autoregressive generation by optimizing expert activation patterns during decoding.

title: Epistemic Stance Flexibility Probing: Measuring Prompt-Conditioned Register Shift in Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces "Epistemic Stance Flexibility Probing" to measure how Large Language Models shift their communicative register based on prompts. The goal is to assess their ability to distinguish between expert opinions and their own "beliefs" for trustworthy conversational responses.

title: The One-Word Census: Answer-Choice Conformity Across 44 Language Models
summary: This study conducts "The One-Word Census," analyzing answer-choice conformity across 44 language models when presented with equally valid options. It characterizes the phenomenon of convergence, noting that models frequently pick the same answers, such as "serendipity."

title: Knowledgeless Language Models: Suppressing Parametric Recall for Evidence-Grounded Language Modeling
summary: This research investigates modifying the pretraining signal to suppress parametric knowledge recall in language models, aiming for more evidence-grounded language modeling. The goal is to mitigate unreliable behavior caused by outdated or misaligned factual knowledge embedded in model parameters.

title: Can LLMs Write Reliable Rubrics? A Meta-Evaluation for Experiment Reproduction
summary: This paper meta-evaluates whether Large Language Models can reliably write rubrics for assessing open-ended outputs from LLM-based research agents, particularly for experiment reproduction. It addresses the challenge of creating paper-specific rubrics, which typically requires significant expert effort.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Misconceptions in Multi-Turn Medical Conversations
summary: This research evaluates Large Language Models on their ability to identify and correct misconceptions within multi-turn medical conversations. The study focuses on the critical aspect of safe medical communication when patients embed incorrect assumptions in their questions.

title: LLM Judges Can Be Too Generous When There Is No Reference Answer
summary: This paper explores the reliability of LLM judges for evaluating open-ended model responses in no-reference settings, revealing that they can be overly generous. The research investigates this phenomenon through a two-stage pipeline to understand the challenges of reliable assessment.

title: The Illusion of Robustness: Aggregate Accuracy Hides Prediction Flips under Task-Irrelevant Context
summary: This research uncovers that the aggregate accuracy of Large Language Models can create an "illusion of robustness," masking prediction flips when exposed to task-irrelevant context. It highlights how state-of-the-art models' performance can degrade under such conditions.

title: PalmClaw: A Native On-Device Agent Framework for Mobile Phones
summary: This paper introduces PalmClaw, a native on-device agent framework specifically designed for mobile phones, enabling LLM agents to execute multi-step tasks by calling tools and iteratively deciding actions. It aims to bring advanced agent capabilities to mobile devices, which are often overlooked in agent system development.

title: From Words to Widgets for Controllable LLM Generation
summary: This paper proposes Malleable Prompting, a new interactive technique to enhance user control over Large Language Model generation, particularly for subjective preferences like tone and style. It aims to address the challenges users face in precisely expressing desired outputs through natural language prompting.

title: QDEvo: A Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Framework for Automated Heuristic Design
summary: This paper introduces QDEvo, a multi-objective quality-diversity framework that integrates Large Language Models with evolutionary computation for automated heuristic design in combinatorial optimization. It aims to overcome mode collapse and enhance semantic diversity in existing approaches.

title: An Empirical Analysis of Continual Learning for Heterogeneous Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: This paper presents an empirical analysis of continual learning for heterogeneous medical visual question answering (MedVQA) systems. It investigates how models can adapt to new clinical tasks in real-world settings without forgetting previously acquired knowledge.

title: Code-MUE: Measuring Code LLMs' Uncertainty through Execution-based Semantic Interaction Graphs
summary: This paper introduces Code-MUE, a method for measuring the uncertainty of Code Large Language Models through execution-based semantic interaction graphs. It aims to enhance reliable automation in software engineering by allowing the distinction of minor errors with significant consequences.

title: The Sound of Absence: Audio-Language Embedding Models Struggle with Negation
summary: This research reveals that audio-language embedding models, like CLAP, struggle with understanding negation, a limitation hidden by affirmation-only evaluations. The study shows these models fail to encode negated sound concepts, mapping affirmative and negated captions similarly.

title: A JoLT for the KV Cache: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Joint Tucker and JL-Residual Allocation for LLMs
summary: This paper introduces "A JoLT for the KV Cache," a near-lossless compression method for the key-value (KV) cache in LLMs, using Joint Tucker and JL-Residual Allocation. The goal is to reduce the dominant memory cost of transformer inference, especially at long context lengths.

title: TSCA-Net: Temporal-Spatial Clique Attention for Interpretable Multimodal Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
summary: This paper introduces TSCA-Net, a model utilizing Temporal-Spatial Clique Attention for interpretable multimodal pedestrian trajectory prediction in crowded environments. The model aims to address challenges posed by the uncertainty of human motion and complex motion dynamics.

title: GenDiff: A Dose and Anatomy Aware Diffusion Model with Structural Prior Refinement for Low-Dose CT Reconstruction and Generalization
summary: This paper introduces GenDiff, a diffusion model designed for low-dose CT reconstruction that incorporates dose and anatomical information to improve image quality and generalization.

title: Anomalous Frame Detection Using VLM-Based Description Comparison for Extracting Expert-Specific Actions and Contextual Decision-Making Scenes with Intra-Video Self-Similarity
summary: This work presents a VLM-based method for detecting anomalous frames and extracting expert-specific actions from videos, aiming to transfer expert knowledge for critical infrastructure maintenance.

title: SpikeDS: Dual Sparsity Spikformer for Perineural Invasion Prediction in 3D MRI
summary: This study introduces SpikeDS, a Dual Sparsity Spikformer model, for predicting perineural invasion from 3D MRI scans in cholangiocarcinoma patients, addressing challenges in detecting subtle imaging signatures.

title: Anatomy-Privileged Distillation with Token Routing for MRI-Based Prediction of Perineural Invasion
summary: This research proposes an Anatomy-Privileged Distillation method with Token Routing for improved MRI-based prediction of perineural invasion in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, moving beyond reliance on manual annotations.

title: MetaView: Monocular Novel View Synthesis with Scale-Aware Implicit Geometry Priors
summary: MetaView is introduced as a novel model for monocular novel view synthesis, utilizing scale-aware implicit geometry priors to generate spatially coherent visual content from a single image.

title: SymbOmni: Evolving Agentic Omni Models via Symbolic Concept Learning
summary: SymbOmni is presented as a framework for evolving agentic omni models through symbolic concept learning, enabling AI systems to learn cumulatively and autonomously, thus overcoming limitations of monolithic models.

title: Representation and Reference Selection in Training-Free Synthetic Image Attribution
summary: This work explores methods for representation and reference selection in training-free synthetic image attribution, aiming to identify the generator responsible for AI-generated images without needing retraining.

title: NEEDL-Bench: Dataset for Swiss Needle Cast and Stomata Detection in Microscopy Images
summary: NEEDL-Bench is introduced as a new dataset and microscopy detection benchmark for identifying Swiss Needle Cast and stomata in microscopy images, crucial for assessing the fungal disease in Douglas-fir trees.

title: ACZ-GSeg: Adaptive Concentric Zone-based Two-stage Ground Segmentation for LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: ACZ-GSeg is presented as an Adaptive Concentric Zone-based Two-stage Ground Segmentation method for LiDAR point clouds, designed to improve ground segmentation for autonomous navigation in challenging environments.

title: Self-Consistent Flow: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Rectified Flow Models
summary: This paper introduces Self-Consistent Flow, a method that unifies velocity and endpoint prediction for rectified flow models, aiming to improve denoising and understanding of these generative models.

title: From Reconstruction to Interpretation: Zero-Setup Multi-Phase Segmentation of X-ray Tomography Data
summary: This research presents a zero-setup multi-phase segmentation method for X-ray tomography data, enabling rapid interpretation of material microstructures by automating image segmentation.

title: A Calibrated Multimodal Ensemble for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition: System Description and Private-Test Submission Strategy
summary: This entry describes a calibrated multimodal ensemble system developed for the ABAW A/H challenge, designed to automatically recognize ambivalence and hesitancy from video data.

title: RegHead: Non-Humanoid Head Blendshapes via Feed-Forward Registration
summary: RegHead is a framework for constructing semantic blendshape sets for animatable non-humanoid head avatars, providing a low-dimensional and interpretable animation interface.

title: Beyond Perfect Priors: Adaptive Gaussian Graph for 4D Driving Reconstruction in the Wild
summary: This work introduces an Adaptive Gaussian Graph method for 4D driving scene reconstruction in the wild, improving upon existing methods by being less reliant on perfect priors for autonomous driving simulation.

title: The GEST-Engine: From Event Graphs to Synthetic Video. A Full Technical Report
summary: The GEST-Engine is a complete system described in this technical report, capable of generating fully-annotated multi-actor videos from natural-language text by utilizing an explicit world model.

title: How to Realize Recursively Self-Improving Agents and Personal Singularity: A Goal-, Scope-, Tool-, and Benchmark-Driven Multi-Agent Architecture
summary: This paper explores a Goal-, Scope-, Tool-, and Benchmark-Driven Multi-Agent Architecture for realizing recursively self-improving agents, aiming to enhance their learning and action mechanisms towards personal singularity.

title: Auditing Data Leakage in Whole-Slide Image Multimodal Benchmarks
summary: This study audits vision-language model benchmarks for computational pathology, revealing significant data leakage issues at multiple levels that compromise the reported zero-shot performance.

title: Semantic-Edge Response Decoding of SAM3 for Zero-Shot Crack Segmentation
summary: This research proposes a Semantic-Edge Response Decoding method for SAM3, enabling zero-shot crack segmentation for infrastructure inspection without requiring extensive task-specific annotations.

title: Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion with Sparse Attention for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction
summary: This paper introduces an Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion method with Sparse Attention for improved pedestrian crossing intention prediction, a safety-critical task for autonomous driving systems.

title: MobileSAM2: Lightweight Segment Anything for Spatial Intelligence
summary: MobileSAM2 is presented as a lightweight version of the SAM2 foundation model, designed to enable segment anything capabilities on resource-constrained devices like mobile phones and laptops for spatial intelligence.

title: What Does a Temporal Benchmark Score Measure? Decomposing Channel Use in Video VLM Evaluation
summary: This item evaluates how temporal video question answering benchmarks measure a model's temporal understanding, differentiating between task and channel questions.

title: DM-KG: A Novel Method for Boosting Spatial Cognition of Vision-Language Models in Street View Imagery
summary: This research introduces DM-KG, a novel method designed to improve the spatial cognition capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when processing street view imagery.

title: ACID: Adaptive Caching for vIDeo generation
summary: This research presents ACID, an adaptive caching method aimed at accelerating video generation in diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs during inference.

title: Lost in Visual Translation: A VLM-Assisted Perceptual-Semantic Coherence Framework for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction
summary: This research introduces a VLM-assisted perceptual-semantic coherence framework for evaluating EEG-to-image reconstruction, addressing issues with visual fidelity and semantic meaning in blurry reconstructions.

title: UMSS: Towards Unsupervised Multi-modal Semantic Segmentation
summary: This research proposes UMSS, an unsupervised multi-modal semantic segmentation approach to overcome the high cost of human annotations for robust perception in complex environments.

title: IQA-T1: Tool-based Visual Evidence Reasoning for Image Quality Assessment
summary: This research introduces IQA-T1, a tool-based visual evidence reasoning approach using multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to improve image quality assessment in open-world environments.

title: Demonstration of the common dual-channel feature decoupling characteristic of front-door mediation causal inference methods in whole-slice image classification
summary: This item demonstrates a common feature decoupling characteristic of causal inference methods used in whole-slide image classification for digital pathology, employing front-door intervention and multi-instance learning.

title: SeamGen: Artist-Aligned UV Seam Generation via Graph Flow Matching
summary: This research introduces SeamGen, a method for artist-aligned UV seam generation in 3D content creation using graph flow matching, aiming to automate a labor-intensive step.

title: Physically Aware Radiomics Without Interpolation: Disentangling Voxel Geometry and Signal Modification in CT and MRI
summary: This research develops a voxel-spacing-aware radiomic framework that disentangles voxel geometry and signal modification in CT and MRI, enabling physically aware radiomics without interpolation.

title: Contrastive-Augmented Flow Matching for Style-Content Disentanglement
summary: This research introduces Contrastive-Augmented Flow Matching to learn disentangled content and style representations in diffusion and flow-based models for more controllable generation.

title: MQAdapter: Multi-Modal Quantum Adapter for Coarse-to-Fine VLM Fine-tuning
summary: This research presents MQAdapter, a multi-modal quantum adapter designed for coarse-to-fine fine-tuning of Vision-Language Models to improve few-shot classification capabilities.

title: DeGuNet: Depth-Guided Ultra-Compact Backbones for Efficient LiDAR-Camera 3D Detection
summary: This research introduces DeGuNet, a depth-guided ultra-compact backbone for efficient LiDAR-camera 3D detection, addressing the reliance on massive visual backbones in autonomous driving perception.

title: More Than Where You Are: Learning Semantics, Structure, and Geometry from Cross-View Localization
summary: This research explores learning semantics, structure, and geometry from cross-view localization to enhance spatial intelligence and enable models to recognize scenes across extreme viewpoint changes.

title: ARDepth: Auto-regressive Monocular Depth Estimation with Progressive Visual Conditioning
summary: This research introduces ARDepth, an auto-regressive monocular depth estimation method using diffusion models with progressive visual conditioning, addressing limitations in recovering smooth depth fields.

title: Let RGB Be the Language of Vision
summary: This work proposes a unified formulation for vision models where diverse visual information, such as masks and depth maps, are all represented as RGB images for general RGB-to-RGB visual tasks.

title: Steering Diffusion Models via Class-Contrastive Influence for Few-Shot Medical Classification
summary: This research presents a method for steering diffusion models via class-contrastive influence to augment training sets for few-shot medical image classification when labeled data is scarce.

title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
summary: This item focuses on benchmarking self-awareness and spatial cognition in UAV embodied intelligence, particularly for autonomous UAV systems relying on multimodal large language models (MLLMs).

title: TerraLogic: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Geospatial Reasoning in Earth Observation
summary: This item introduces TerraLogic, a new benchmark specifically designed for hierarchical geospatial reasoning in Earth Observation, addressing the need for advanced interpretation and decision-making.

title: DynTrace: Tracking Dynamic Object Evidence for 4D Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in MLLMs
summary: This research introduces DynTrace, a method for tracking dynamic object evidence to enable 4D spatio-temporal reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

title: DiTailed: Ensuring Visual Object Consistency in Text-Image-to-Image Flow Matching Models
summary: This paper introduces DiTailed, a method to improve visual object consistency in text-image-to-image flow matching models, addressing issues where generative models fail to preserve key attributes during editing.

title: CGRL: Concept-Guided Pruning and Representation Learning for Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: This research presents Concept-Guided Pruning and Representation Learning (CGRL) for weakly supervised whole-slide image classification, aiming to improve computational pathology by addressing limitations in existing multiple instance learning methods.

title: Gaussian Mixture Modeling for Event-Aware Visual Allocation in Long Video Understanding
summary: This paper proposes a Gaussian Mixture Modeling approach for event-aware visual allocation, designed to mitigate computational costs and information loss in Large Vision-Language Models for long video understanding.

title: Traceback Translators Against Forgetting in Continual Fake Speech Detection
summary: This research introduces Traceback Translators to combat catastrophic forgetting in continual learning for fake speech detection, helping models adapt to new generative AI developments without performance degradation.

title: WanToFight: Real-Time Generative Game Engine for Multi-Player Combat Interaction
summary: WanToFight is a real-time generative game engine that simulates multi-player combat interaction from keyboard input for games like The King of Fighters '97, overcoming limitations of prior generative game engines.

title: EFLUX: Elastic Multi-Robot Formation Navigation and Adaptation with Agentic LLMs
summary: EFLUX proposes an elastic multi-robot formation navigation and adaptation system that uses agentic LLMs to allow robot teams to dynamically reshape their geometry and topology in complex environments.

title: Enabling 24-hour Agricultural Robotics: Unsupervised Day-to-Night Cross-Modal Image Translation for Nighttime Visual Navigation
summary: This research addresses 24-hour agricultural robotics by developing unsupervised day-to-night cross-modal image translation for nighttime visual navigation, enabling autonomous robots to operate in low-light conditions.

title: Robust In-Hand Manipulation via Priors in Reinforcement Learning and Mechanical Design
summary: This research explores robust in-hand manipulation for robots by incorporating priors into reinforcement learning and mechanical design, aiming to maintain stable grasps despite uncertainties and disturbances.

title: GaitSpan: Growing Humanoid Locomotion from Walking to Running
summary: GaitSpan introduces a method for growing humanoid locomotion from walking to running, allowing humanoids to learn diverse gaits without relearning from scratch for different movement speeds.

title: A Behavioral State Vocabulary in Sony ERS-111 R-CODE
summary: This paper analyzes a corpus of generated behavior diagrams from Sony's ERS-111 AIBO R-CODE samples, identifying recurring control vocabulary that structures the robot's actions.

title: More than a Manipulator: Planning Propellant-Free Attitude Maneuvers for Free-Floating Spacecraft
summary: This research explores using robotic manipulators on free-floating spacecraft to plan propellant-free attitude maneuvers, treating them as actuators rather than disturbance sources for spacecraft control.

title: Analysis of Mutual and Referential Human and Robot Gazes in a Collaborative Word Association Game
summary: This paper analyzes mutual and referential gazes between humans and robots during a collaborative word association game, investigating how robot gaze contributes to human-robot dialogue coordination in task-focused interactions.

title: Contract-Grounded Behavior Tree Synthesis via Coding Agents
summary: This research proposes contract-grounded behavior tree synthesis using coding agents, enabling the creation of deployable robot behavior trees from natural language instructions by ensuring grounded execution.

title: DiffRadar: Differentiable Physics-Aware Radar SLAM with Gaussian Fields
summary: DiffRadar introduces a differentiable, physics-aware Radar SLAM system using Gaussian Fields, designed to improve motion estimation for mobile systems by operating reliably under challenging environmental conditions.

title: Reducing Temporal Redundancy for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: This research aims to reduce temporal redundancy in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to achieve efficient inference for real-time robotic manipulation, by optimizing repeated visual encoding.

title: VistaVLA: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware 3D Gaussian-Grounded VLA for Robotic Manipulation
summary: VistaVLA presents a geometry- and semantic-aware 3D Gaussian-grounded Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model to enhance robotic manipulation by enabling explicit scene-level 3D representation and improved spatial reasoning from language instructions.

title: StratMamba: Strategic and Reactive Stream Partitioning for Path-Efficient LiDAR-Based Obstacle Avoidance
summary: StratMamba is a Mamba-based temporal modeling architecture designed for path-efficient LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance and robot navigation in complex environments, utilizing strategic and reactive stream partitioning.

title: Model-Based Diffusion Optimal Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning
summary: This paper introduces Model-Based Diffusion Optimal Control for Multi-Robot Motion Planning, addressing the challenge of generating dynamically feasible and collision-free trajectories for multiple robots in continuous environments.

title: Deployable Human Preference Alignment in Robotics: Learning Representative Rewards from Diverse Human Preferences
summary: This research focuses on deployable human preference alignment in robotics by learning representative rewards from diverse human preferences, addressing challenges like sparse feedback and individualized policies.

title: Infra-Swarm: Robust Vision-Based Multi-Robot Swarming via Near-Infrared Spectral Vision
summary: Infra-Swarm proposes a robust vision-based multi-robot swarming system that utilizes near-infrared spectral vision to overcome limitations of traditional communication or passive vision methods in distributed robot swarms.

title: Mind the Gap: Promises and Pitfalls of Hierarchical Planning in LeWorldModel
summary: This paper investigates hierarchical planning to improve the LeWorldModel's performance on long-horizon goal-conditioned control tasks, introducing an extension called Hi-LeWM.

title: TrustVLA: Mechanism-Guided Inference-Time Defense Against Vision-Language-Action Backdoors
summary: This paper proposes TrustVLA, a defense mechanism against backdoors in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, addressing the risk of poisoned models redirecting robot policies.

title: Streamlining stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free real-time tracking of surgical robots
summary: This research evaluates stereo differentiable rendering for marker-free, real-time pose tracking of surgical robots, aiming to improve safety and reduce setup time.

title: Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps for Visual Language Navigation
summary: This paper proposes using instance-enriched semantic maps to enable embodied AI agents to navigate complex environments based on natural language instructions.

title: Jetson-PI: Towards Onboard Real-Time Robot Control via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Inference
summary: This work addresses challenges in deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on low-power onboard devices like the Jetson Orin for real-time robot control.

title: Vision-Based Dribbling for Humanoid Soccer via Privileged Representation Learning
summary: This paper describes a method for vision-based dribbling in humanoid robots for soccer, focusing on loco-manipulation skills, balance, and ball control.

title: Globalized Constrained Stein Variational Inference for Diverse Feasible Robot Motion Planning
summary: This research introduces a method using Stein Variational Inference for robot motion planning to generate diverse and feasible solutions, addressing the multimodal nature of robot movements.

title: Directional Constraints for Efficient Exploration in Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper investigates directional constraints within Safe Reinforcement Learning to enable robust learning of complex robotic skills with strong safety guarantees for real-world deployment.

title: Unveiling Complex Collective Behaviors from Simple Rewards
summary: This research explores how complex collective behaviors can emerge in robot swarms from simple rewards using Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL).

title: UR-VC: Unsupervised Robotic Value Correction for Time-Derived Progress Proxies
summary: This paper presents UR-VC, an unsupervised method for correcting value signals in robot learning systems to improve policy learning and task completion detection.

title: ExToken: Structured Exploration for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning
summary: This work proposes ExToken, a method for structured exploration to improve the efficiency of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model fine-tuning for complex robotic manipulation tasks.

title: MAMMOTH: A Multi-Modal End-to-End Policy for Off-Road Mobility Robust to Missing Modality
summary: This paper presents MAMMOTH, a multi-modal end-to-end policy for reliable autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments, even with missing sensor data.

title: ChunkFlow: Towards Continuity-Consistent Chunked Policy Learning
summary: This paper introduces ChunkFlow, a method to achieve continuity-consistent chunked policy learning in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, improving temporal coherence and task success rates.

title: FlowWAM: Optical Flow as a Unified Action Representation for World Action Models
summary: This research proposes FlowWAM, utilizing optical flow as a unified action representation to enable World Action Models (WAMs) to leverage pretrained video generators for control and action prediction.

title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper introduces DenseReward, a method for dense reward learning via failure synthesis, aiming to provide informative feedback for improving robot policies in manipulation tasks.

title: Improving Autonomous Nano-drones Performance via Automated End-to-End Optimization and Deployment of DNNs
summary: This research focuses on optimizing and deploying Deep Neural Networks for autonomous nano-drones to enhance their performance, leveraging energy-efficient processors.

title: Practical Judgment, Virtue, and Intuition in the Use of Opaque AI-Enabled Systems
summary: This paper explores the ethical and practical challenges posed by "black box" AI systems, focusing on the role of human judgment, virtue, and intuition in their deployment.

title: TerraZero: Procedural Driving Simulation for Zero-Demonstration Self-Play at Scale
summary: This paper introduces TerraZero, a procedural driving simulator designed for training robust autonomous driving agents at scale using reinforcement learning and self-play.

title: Seeing Through Uncertainty: Free-Energy-Inspired Real-Time Adaptation for Robust Visual Navigation
summary: This paper explores a free-energy-inspired method for real-time adaptation to achieve robust visual navigation, addressing challenges in uncertain sensory environments.

title: RoboDesign1M: A Large-scale Dataset for Robot Design Understanding
summary: This article discusses RoboDesign1M, a large-scale dataset aimed at understanding robot design data to enable AI-powered design generation and retrieval.

title: Robot Drummer: Learning Rhythmic Skills for Humanoid Drumming
summary: This paper explores how humanoid robots can learn and perform complex rhythmic skills required for drumming, showcasing advances in expressive physical robot capabilities.

title: Look, Focus, Act: Efficient and Robust Robot Learning via Human Gaze and Foveated Vision Transformers
summary: This research explores a novel robot learning method that utilizes human gaze and foveated vision transformers to achieve more efficient and robust visual processing for robots.

title: Diffusion Denoiser-Aided Gyrocompassing
summary: This research introduces a method to improve gyrocompassing for accurate initial heading angles by using a diffusion denoiser, an AI technique, for better navigation.

title: Real-Time Model Checking for Closed-Loop Robot Reactive Planning
summary: This paper proposes using real-time model checking to enable reactive multi-step planning and obstacle avoidance for robots, addressing limitations of single-step reasoning.

title: LapSurgie: Humanoid Robots Performing Surgery via Teleoperated Handheld Laparoscopy
summary: This article describes LapSurgie, a system where humanoid robots perform surgical procedures using teleoperated handheld laparoscopy, highlighting advances in surgical robotics.

title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
summary: This paper presents DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that integrates vision, proprioception, and tactile signals for bimanual dexterous manipulation in robots.

title: Expert Knowledge-driven Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Racing via Trajectory Guidance and Dynamics Constraints
summary: This research applies expert knowledge-driven reinforcement learning to enhance autonomous racing by providing trajectory guidance and dynamics constraints, improving safety and stability.

title: TADPO: Reinforcement Learning Goes Off-road
summary: This article introduces TADPO, a reinforcement learning approach designed for challenging off-road autonomous driving scenarios, tackling unmapped and variable terrains.

title: APPLV: Adaptive Planner Parameter Learning from Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: This paper introduces APPLV, a method for adaptive planner parameter learning from Vision-Language-Action models to improve autonomous navigation for mobile robots in constrained environments.

title: Mosaic: An Extensible Framework for Composing Rule-Based and Learned Motion Planners
summary: This article presents Mosaic, an extensible framework that combines rule-based and learned motion planners to address the challenges of safe and explainable motion planning in autonomous driving.

title: Motubrain: An Advanced World Action Model for Robot Control
summary: This paper introduces Motubrain, a unified World Action Model (WAM) that integrates video and action under a UniDiffuser formulation with a three-stream Mixture-of-Transformers architecture for robot control.

title: SANTS: A State-Adaptive Scheduler for World Action Models
summary: This research proposes SANTS, a state-adaptive scheduler designed to optimize the performance of World Action Models (WAMs) by controlling denoising depth for improved robot manipulation.

title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
summary: This paper presents RoboWorld, a system of fast and reliable neural simulators based on video world models, designed for evaluating generalist robot policies more efficiently.

title: McKinsey Boss Says AI Could Mean Golden Age for Consultancy Firm - Bloomberg.com
summary: The head of McKinsey & Company suggests that artificial intelligence could lead to a 'golden age' for the consulting firm, highlighting AI's strategic business impact.

title: Tesla, Waymo expand rides in Miami - The Palm Beach Post
