summary: This paper explores efficient and privacy-aware edge-cloud collaborative inference for large language models, addressing challenges like latency, limited hardware, and user privacy on edge devices. It contrasts full cloud and standalone on-device inference, proposing a hybrid solution.

title: Analyzing Curricular Pattern Complexity Using AI to Improve On-Time Graduation Rates
summary: This work utilizes artificial intelligence techniques to analyze and revise complex curricular patterns in undergraduate degree programs. The goal is to improve on-time graduation rates by making previously labor-intensive data analysis tasks more efficient.

title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
summary: This paper presents full-pipeline inference optimization techniques for the MiMo-V2.5 model family, focusing on enhancing efficiency. It details how Hybrid Sliding Window Attention, sparse Mixture-of-Experts, and multimodal encoders are combined to reduce attention compute and KVCache storage.

title: WaterMoE: Expert-Routing-based Watermarking for High Fidelity and Efficiency
summary: This paper introduces WaterMoE, an expert-routing-based watermarking technique designed for large language models (LLMs) to ensure high fidelity and efficiency. It aims to address concerns about content provenance and misuse, which have limited the practical adoption of previous watermarking methods.

title: Automatic Differentiation from Scratch: How PyTorch Computes Gradients in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: This paper details how PyTorch's automatic differentiation engine computes gradients for Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) training, providing explicit numerical values. It clarifies the two levels of differentiation required in this setting.

title: What Your Model Threw Away and Why You'll Want It Back: Masking, Fingerprinting, and Privacy from Discarded Geometry
summary: This paper develops a framework to analyze information discarded by machine learning models whose inputs are subject to a Lie group action. It explores how this discarded "geometry" relates to masking, fingerprinting, and privacy.

title: Targeted Recovery of Weight-Space Mechanisms From Neural Networks
summary: This paper proposes targeted parameter decomposition (tPD) as a method to recover interpretable weight-space mechanisms from neural networks. This approach aims to make large models more understandable by breaking them into computational components, addressing the high computational cost of traditional parameter decomposition.

title: TSSM: Triaxial State Space Model for Global Station Weather Forecasting with Temporal-Variable-Historical Modeling
summary: This paper introduces TSSM, a Triaxial State Space Model for Global Station Weather Forecasting that incorporates temporal-variable-historical modeling. This new approach aims to improve accuracy in localized and extreme weather prediction, addressing limitations of existing methods.

title: Disentangling Knowledge States with Ability and Proficiency Modeling for Knowledge Tracing
summary: This paper proposes a new method for knowledge tracing (KT) that disentangles students' knowledge states using ability and proficiency modeling. The approach aims to improve the prediction of future student performance by accounting for the phase-specific nature of learning behaviors.

title: A Hybrid Mamba for Audio-Visual Navigation
summary: This paper introduces a Hybrid Mamba architecture for audio-visual navigation, aiming to update the fundamental backbone networks in this field. It addresses the inadequacy of long-standing convolutional and recurrent network paradigms for efficient representation.

title: CoDiffGRN: Rethinking Gene Regulatory Network Inference via the BEELINE-KGC Benchmark and Co-evolutionary Discrete Diffusion
summary: This paper introduces CoDiffGRN, a new method for inferring gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell transcriptomic data using co-evolutionary discrete diffusion. The approach is evaluated against the BEELINE-KGC benchmark, addressing misalignments of existing methods with real-world biological needs.

title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
summary: This paper introduces ShortOPD, a method using Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation to recover the performance of pruned large language models (LLMs). It aims to address the issue of pruned LLMs collapsing on free-form generation tasks despite being validated on multiple-choice recognition.

title: SteinGate: Tail-Sensitive Safe Reinforcement Learning via Stein Discrepancy
summary: This paper introduces SteinGate, a new approach for tail-sensitive safe reinforcement learning that uses a boundary-aware distributional safety certificate based on Stein Discrepancy. It aims to overcome limitations of traditional safe RL methods that often fail to detect rare but catastrophic tail events.

title: Concurrent Image Understanding and Generation: Self-Correcting Coupled Markov Jump Processes
summary: This paper explores concurrent image understanding and generation in artificial systems using self-correcting coupled Markov Jump Processes. It proposes integrating understanding and generation, similar to human cognition, leveraging Masked Diffusion Models.

title: EMAGN: Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network via Learned Clustering for Scalable Traffic Forecasting
summary: This paper introduces EMAGN, an Efficient Multi-Attention Graph Network that uses learned clustering to improve scalability in traffic forecasting by modeling complex spatiotemporal dependencies.

title: Reassessing Muon for Matrix Factorization
summary: This research re-evaluates Muon, an optimizer for large-scale deep learning, finding it outperforms Adam and AdamW in large language model training by reshaping gradient updates through approximate orthogonalization.

title: Deconstructing Actor-Critic: A Large-scale Empirical Study of Design Components for Practitioners
summary: This empirical study deconstructs Actor-Critic reinforcement learning algorithms, examining their design components to improve reliability and reduce tuning budgets for real-world control systems.

title: Tabular Foundation Models for Discrete Choice Estimation
summary: This paper investigates the application of tabular foundation models (TFMs) for discrete choice estimation in marketing and operations, evaluating their effectiveness without task-specific estimation.

title: Accuracy-Preserving Stability Regularization for Large-Scale Retail Demand Forecasting
summary: This research proposes a training-time penalty, Accuracy-Preserving Stability Regularization, to constrain abrupt forecast movements and improve the stability and accuracy of large-scale retail demand forecasts.

title: Agora: Collective and Permissionless Internet-Scale Pretraining of Large Language Models
summary: This paper introduces Agora, a method for collective and permissionless internet-scale pretraining of large language models, overcoming datacenter limitations for multi-billion to trillion parameter models.

title: Where Should RL Post-Training Compute Go? Model Size, Search, Learning, and Feedback
summary: This study explores how to optimally allocate compute resources during reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for foundation models used in reasoning, planning, and robot-learning pipelines.

title: Self-Improving is Often Sudden: Enlightenment-style Finetuning for Large-Scale Models
summary: This research explores an 'enlightenment-style' finetuning phenomenon in large-scale models, hypothesizing that self-improvement often occurs suddenly, similar to human 'aha moments'.

title: EXPLORE: Exploration with Guided Search for Analog Topology Generation using Language Models
summary: This paper presents EXPLORE, a method using pretrained language models with guided search and sequence-to-sequence fine-tuning to automate analog circuit topology generation.

title: OrDA: Orthogonal Disentanglement of Access Habits Framework for Homepage Marketing Block Recommendations
summary: This paper proposes OrDA, an Orthogonal Disentanglement of Access Habits Framework, to improve homepage marketing block recommendations by separating content interest from habitual clicks, reducing bias.

title: Temperature Scaling Is Not Enough: Calibration Gaps Under Human Label Distributions
summary: This study argues that temperature scaling is insufficient for calibration in deep learning, highlighting calibration gaps when ground-truth labels are soft, crowd-sourced, or non-deterministic.

title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of LLMs via Attention Head Reweighting
summary: This research introduces Attention Head Reweighting as a parameter-efficient adaptation method to improve data-efficient learning for large language models (LLMs) in domains with scarce labeled data.

title: PUe: Biased Positive-Unlabeled Learning Enhancement by Causal Inference
summary: This paper introduces PUe, a Positive-Unlabeled learning enhancement method that uses causal inference to improve binary classification accuracy when only limited positive examples are labeled.

title: Discrete Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework from Tokenization to Generation
summary: This paper proposes a unified framework for discrete denoising diffusion models (DDMs), offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive modeling for parallel generation and iterative global refinement of discrete data.

title: Local Redundancy: An Information-Theoretic Measure of Plasticity from Synthetic Memorization
summary: This paper introduces Local Redundancy, an information-theoretic measure of neural network plasticity, which aims to better correlate with performance in continual and transfer learning than existing metrics.

title: PQFA: Parallel Quantum Feature Augmentation of Fused Representations for Multimodal Classification
summary: This paper proposes PQFA, a Parallel Quantum Feature Augmentation framework, a hybrid quantum-classical method that enhances fused representations using shallow variational quantum circuits for multimodal classification.

title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Anomaly Detection in Banking Transactions: An Internal Audit Perspective
summary: This paper examines the application of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for anomaly detection in banking transactions, focusing on its utility for internal audit and compliance in combating fraud.

title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
summary: This paper introduces DeepLoop, a method for depth scaling in Looped Transformers that applies a compact stack of physical blocks multiple times to increase unrolled depth without increasing stored parameters.

title: A VAE-Driven Multi-Task Satellite-Aided Semantic Communication Framework for 6G-Enabled Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary: This paper proposes a VAE-driven multi-task satellite-aided semantic communication framework for 6G-enabled Connected Autonomous Vehicles, aiming for bandwidth-efficient, reliable, and low-latency communication.

title: Factorized Spectral Representations for Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents Factorized Spectral Representations, a method for learning compact world models from interaction data to achieve sample-efficient deep reinforcement learning by viewing the transition kernel spectrally.

title: ExTernD: Expanded-Rank Ternary Decomposition Ternary LLM PTQ with Accuracy Approaching Any Quantization Level
summary: This paper introduces ExTernD, a post-training quantization method for LLMs that uses expanded-rank ternary decomposition to factorize weight matrices. This technique aims to maintain high accuracy while making LLMs more efficient.

title: Structured Reinforcement Learning for Bayesian Persuasion : Application to Intelligent Interactive Driving
summary: This paper introduces a structured reinforcement learning method for Bayesian persuasion, applying it to intelligent interactive driving to coordinate route choices of connected vehicles for dynamic traffic management.

title: Gauge-Invariant, Parameter-Insensitive Regularization for Potential Recovery from Flow on Directed Graphs
summary: This paper proposes a gauge-invariant, parameter-insensitive regularization method for recovering a latent potential from observed flow on directed graphs, addressing issues with standard regularization techniques.

title: The SIGReg Objective as Variational Free Energy: A Theoretical Active-Inference Account of JEPA World Models
summary: This paper provides a theoretical active-inference account of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) world models, showing how the choice of anti-collapse regularizer determines their training objective as variational free energy.

title: FastCentNN: Accelerating Centroid Neural Network with Entropy Proxy
summary: This report proposes FastCentNN, an accelerated variant of the Centroid Neural Network, which is an unsupervised competitive learning algorithm. It aims to reduce prolonged low-movement training phases by using an entropy proxy.

title: How the Hessian-Spectrum of Neural Networks Depends on Data
summary: This paper investigates how the Hessian-spectrum of neural networks depends on data, exploring its role in understanding the loss landscape, optimization dynamics, and generalization in deep learning.

title: Consensus as Privileged Context for Label-Free Self-Distillation
summary: This paper proposes using "Consensus as Privileged Context" for label-free self-distillation, a method to improve the reasoning accuracy of large language models by converting consensus signals into training supervision.

title: The Hyperspherical Geometry of CLIP Latent Space: A Semantic Mixture Model
summary: This paper analyzes the hyperspherical geometry of CLIP's latent space, which is governed by cosine similarity, and proposes a semantic mixture model to better capture its directional nature.

title: Conditional Invertible Neural Networks for Data-Driven UAV Control: A 2-D Proof of Concept
summary: This paper investigates conditional invertible neural networks (cINNs) as probabilistic inverse-dynamics models for data-driven control of multirotor UAVs, demonstrating a 2-D proof of concept.

title: DAGR: State-Conditioned Goal Representations via Difference-Aware Goal Cross-Attention
summary: This paper introduces DAGR (Difference-Aware Goal Cross-Attention), a new method for state-conditioned goal representations in goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, addressing the limitation of state-independent goal embeddings.

title: Constraint-Driven Model Optimization: An Industry Framework for Selecting Compression and Acceleration Techniques in Modern Machine Learning Systems
summary: This paper presents an industry framework for constraint-driven model optimization, guiding the selection of compression and acceleration techniques like quantization and pruning for modern machine learning systems.

title: Implementations of Quantum and Classical Topology-Aligned Architectures for Molecular Property Prediction
summary: This paper proposes quantum and classical topology-aligned architectures for molecular property prediction, designed for parameter-efficient learning in low-data, resource-constrained quantum chemistry regimes.

title: Algebraic Representability as the Limiting Regime of Grokking: An Exactly Solvable Model with Holomorphic Activations
summary: This paper investigates the phenomenon of grokking in neural networks, proposing algebraic representability as its limiting regime and studying it using an exactly solvable model with holomorphic activations.

title: MxGPS: Multiplex Graph Transformers for a Power Grid Foundation Model
summary: This paper introduces MxGPS, a Multiplex Graph Transformer architecture designed to create a Power Grid Foundation Model that mitigates topology overfitting encountered in single-task fine-tuning of GNNs.

title: A better way to turn 2D designs into 3D models for rapid prototyping
summary: Researchers developed an automated framework that enhances AI models' ability to generate CAD programs more accurately and efficiently, facilitating the conversion of 2D designs into 3D models for rapid prototyping.

title: Applied Computing wants to give oil and gas operators an AI model for the entire plant
summary: Applied Computing has raised a $20M Series A funding round to develop a foundation AI model tailored for the entire oil, gas, and petrochemical industry.

title: C-Norm: Cell-Distribution Normalization Enables Precision Recognition of Medical-Cell Image
summary: C-Norm is a cell-distribution normalization method designed to enhance the precision recognition of medical-cell images in AI detection models, particularly for ThinPrep Cytologic Test (TCT).

title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
summary: Boogu-Image-0.1 is an open-source, unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, including Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants, offering competitive performance in various tasks.

title: A Masked Autoencoder Approach to Unsupervised Steel Surface Defect Recognition
summary: This paper proposes a Masked Autoencoder approach for unsupervised steel surface defect recognition, leveraging self-supervised methods to learn useful representations from unlabeled surface images.

title: Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning: Pretrain-Finetuning or Joint Training?
summary: This research investigates self-supervised visual representation learning, comparing the efficacy of two primary approaches: a two-stage pretraining and finetuning pipeline versus a joint training method.

title: Continuously Evolving Deepfake Detection: An Architecture and Public-Benchmark Evaluation of a Dynamic Detection System
summary: This paper introduces a continuously evolving architecture for deepfake detection systems, addressing the performance gap between academic benchmarks and real-world content through a dynamic detection system.

title: Active Learning for Efficient Annotation of Surgical Videos with Weak Supervision
summary: This research proposes a human-in-the-loop framework combining active learning and dual-loss optimization to efficiently annotate surgical videos, reducing the expert effort required for spatial-temporal labeling.

title: Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth: Combating Perceptual Saturation in Long-Horizon Robotics
summary: This research proposes a "Just-In-Time Scene Graph Growth" method to combat perceptual saturation in long-horizon robotics by addressing real-time, low-latency demands of 3D Scene Graphs for embodied agents.

title: AffectFlow-DINO: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Task Affect Estimation via Conditional Rectified Flow
summary: AffectFlow-DINO is a multi-task learning system that extends a deterministic architecture with a conditional rectified-flow head to perform uncertainty-aware affect estimation of in-the-wild facial behavior.

title: FOLIO: Focused Semantic Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: FOLIO is proposed as a focused semantic memory system for online streaming video understanding, designed to continuously compress and retain information from observed video prefixes for unbounded streams.

title: Improving Medical Image Generative Models with Fr\'echet Distance Loss
summary: This research aims to improve diffusion generative models for synthetic medical image generation by addressing their limitations in capturing complex tumor morphology, potentially using Fréchet Distance Loss.

title: Accuracy Without Grounding: Diagnosing Visual Dependency Dissociation in Video LLM Benchmarks
summary: This research audits the assumption of visual understanding from benchmark accuracy in video LLMs, introducing the Visual Dependency Gap (VDG) to diagnose visual dependency dissociation across various models and architectures.

title: Reflecting Process Expertise in Procedural Material Generation
summary: This research focuses on reflecting process expertise in procedural material generation to achieve high-quality results in digital content creation, visual effects, and 3D asset design.

title: SARFA: Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment
summary: SARFA (Segment Anything with Radiomic Feature Alignment) is a proposed method to improve the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for medical imaging, addressing its struggles with ambiguous target segmentation in areas like tumor delineation.

title: Delving into the Temporal Challenges of Unified Video Protection Against Image-to-Video and Fine-Tuning-based Customization
summary: This research delves into temporal challenges for unified video protection against high-quality personalized video customization enabled by diffusion-based and image-to-video generation models, addressing related concerns.

title: Marker-free deformable registration and fusion for augmented reality-guided positive margin localization during tumor resection surgery
summary: This research proposes a marker-free deformable registration and fusion method for augmented reality-guided localization of positive margins during tumor resection surgery, aiming to improve surgical precision.

title: Detector Confidence Signals Presence Rather Than Occlusion in Cluttered Manipulation
summary: This research finds that an open-vocabulary object detector's confidence signals object presence rather than occlusion, often remaining high or even rising in cluttered manipulation scenarios, leading to misinterpretations.

title: DiffGI: Differentiable Geometry Images for High-Fidelity Thin-Shell 3D Generation
summary: DiffGI introduces Differentiable Geometry Images for high-fidelity thin-shell 3D generation, providing a surface-centric alternative to volumetric representations that struggle with non-manifold geometries like garments.

title: RoughNet: Mapping Arctic Sea Ice Roughness Using Diffusion-Based Super-Resolution of Satellite Imagery
summary: RoughNet is a proposed method that uses diffusion-based super-resolution of satellite imagery to accurately map Arctic sea ice roughness, addressing limitations of existing costly survey methods for climate modeling.

title: FM$^2$: Unified Federated Foundation Models for Heterogeneous Multimodal Medical Imaging
summary: FM$^2$ introduces Unified Federated Foundation Models for heterogeneous multimodal medical imaging, addressing data privacy concerns by enabling model training across institutions without centralizing sensitive data.

title: MultiAnimate: A Unified Framework for Controllable Multi-Character Animation
summary: MultiAnimate is a unified framework designed for controllable multi-character animation, addressing limitations of existing generative models that primarily focus on single-character animation.

title: ScanFocus: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: ScanFocus is a coarse-to-fine framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG), designed to retrieve specific object trajectories from video streams based on natural language expressions while balancing context modeling and precise localization.

title: CLIP-Guided Label-Free Discriminative Region Scoring for Fine-Grained Classification
summary: This research explores CLIP-guided label-free discriminative region scoring for fine-grained classification, leveraging vision models like CLIP and SAM for training-free segmentation and semantic encoding.

title: DreamSat-Pose: Spacecraft Pose Estimation from Single-View 3D Reconstructions and Learned 2D-3D Feature Matching
summary: DreamSat-Pose is a novel framework for spacecraft pose estimation that uses single-view 3D reconstructions and learned 2D-3D feature matching to determine 6-DoF pose for autonomous rendezvous operations.

title: GeoAnchor: Collaborative Reasoning via Latent Decomposition for 3D Spatial Understanding
summary: GeoAnchor proposes a collaborative reasoning framework using latent decomposition to improve multimodal large language models' understanding of 3D spatial relationships derived from 2D images.

title: TreeSRNF: Square-Root Normal Fields for Generative Modelling of the Geometric and Structural Variability in Tree-like 3D Objects
summary: TreeSRNF introduces a novel mathematical framework using Square-Root Normal Fields for generative modeling, enabling the analysis and creation of complex tree-shaped 3D objects with geometric and structural variability.

title: 2D Rotary Position Embedding for Scene Text Recognition with Transformers
summary: This paper proposes a 2D rotary position embedding for Transformers to improve Scene Text Recognition (STR) by better handling the 2D spatial structure of text.

title: LPM: Industrial-Scale Generative Video Restoration
summary: This introduces the Large Processing Model (LPM), a diffusion-based generative framework for photorealistic video restoration under complex, real-world degradations, reportedly deployed at industrial scale.

title: Bring Music The Horizon: Music-Driven 360$^\circ$ Video Generation
summary: This research explores music visualization by generating immersive 360-degree videos from auditory signals, moving beyond lyric-dependent or flat video generation.

title: GPOcc++: Unified Sparse Gaussian Occupancy Prediction with Visual Geometry Priors
summary: This paper presents GPOcc++, a method for unified sparse Gaussian occupancy prediction using visual geometry priors, aiming to improve 3D scene understanding crucial for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

title: M2P-AD: Memory-to-Prototype Learning with Boundary-aware Score Refinement for 3D Anomaly Detection
summary: This paper introduces M2P-AD, a memory-to-prototype learning method with boundary-aware score refinement to improve 3D anomaly detection by addressing excessive anomaly responses and false positives.

title: Attention-Free and Lightweight Token Reduction for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: This research proposes an attention-free and lightweight token reduction method to improve the efficiency of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making them more deployable on resource-constrained edge devices.

title: TRACE-PCa: Predicting Prostate Cancer Progression from Longitudinal MRI During Active Surveillance
summary: TRACE-PCa is an AI-driven method that predicts prostate cancer progression from longitudinal MRI scans during active surveillance, aiming to reduce unnecessary repeat biopsies.

title: VGIF-Score: Interpretable and Diagnostic Evaluation of Spatio-Temporal Instruction Following in Video Generation
summary: VGIF-Score is introduced as a new interpretable and diagnostic evaluation method for assessing how well video generation models follow long, compositional spatio-temporal instructions.

title: ThinkBLOX: 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Progressive Reasoning
summary: ThinkBLOX is a new approach for 3D indoor scene generation that utilizes progressive reasoning, diverging from traditional autoregressive or one-shot VLM-based methods to improve layout planning.

title: Nexus: Native Mesh Generation with Diffusion
summary: Nexus is a diffusion-based method for generating high-quality triangle meshes, crucial for film, gaming, and interactive 3D applications, addressing challenges faced by traditional autoregressive processes.

title: GHR-VLM: Making Zero-Shot Transit Video Analytics Realizable with Grounded Hybrid Reasoning
summary: GHR-VLM is a method that enables zero-shot transit video analytics by applying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with grounded hybrid reasoning, overcoming limitations of direct VLM application to long onboard videos.

title: UniPhysGen: Unified Physical Grounding for Simulation-Ready 3D Assets
summary: UniPhysGen provides a method for unified physical grounding for 3D assets, endowing them with articulation semantics and intrinsic physical properties required for realistic interaction in embodied AI and robotic simulations.

title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
summary: This report introduces OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model that processes document page images to generate Markdown representations, including text, formulas, tables, and visual regions.

title: Human4K: A Large-Scale 4K Multi-View Mocap Dataset for Whole-Body 3D Human Reconstruction
summary: Human4K is a new large-scale 4K multi-view motion capture dataset designed to advance whole-body 3D human reconstruction, addressing current model limitations in challenging real-world scenarios.

title: Beyond Color Geometry: Evaluating Human-Like Color Representations in Vision Models
summary: This research investigates how vision models represent colors, evaluating their representations against human perception rather than relying solely on geometric spaces or discrete color labels.

title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
summary: This paper proposes vision-driven embodied agents designed for open-world mobile manipulation, focusing on active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation for practical real-world deployment.

title: FreeLit: Paired-Free Indoor Relighting via Physics-Guided Diffusion
summary: FreeLit introduces a physics-guided diffusion method for paired-free indoor relighting, addressing the complexity of light interaction with geometry without requiring paired multi-illumination datasets.

title: Fine-grained CLIP fine-tuning with self-annotated region alignment
summary: This research proposes a fine-tuning method for CLIP models that uses self-annotated region alignment to improve their fine-grained dense feature representation, addressing limitations of whole-image pre-training.

title: Learning Speaker Identity Beyond Language and Modality Constraints: Insights from the POLY-SIM 2026 Challenge
summary: This paper explores speaker identification systems, drawing insights from the POLY-SIM 2026 Challenge to address real-world constraints such as language variability and incomplete audio-visual modalities.

title: WAVE-Stereo: Warp-Aligned Volume Encoding for Stereo Matching
summary: WAVE-Stereo proposes a novel stereo matching method that integrates warp-aligned volume encoding, combining explicit matching search via correlation volumes and local residual refinement via warped features.

title: Towards Spatial Supersensing in the Wild
summary: This paper proposes spatial supersensing as a challenge for multimodal models to develop world modeling beyond linguistic understanding, mimicking human ability to parse continuous sensory streams for spatial reasoning.

title: DNA: Dual-stage Native Attribution for Generated Image Source Tracing
summary: This paper introduces DNA, a dual-stage native attribution method for tracing the source model of generated images, addressing the challenge of identifying the origin of numerous image variants for digital forensics.

title: Barnamala: Parameter-Efficient Handwritten Devanagari Recognition at Benchmark Saturation
summary: Researchers developed Barnamala, a compact convolutional network for handwritten Devanagari recognition, achieving 99.73% accuracy on the DHCD benchmark, reaching a saturation point with a significantly smaller model.

title: HRIBench: Benchmarking Interaction-Centric Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper introduces HRIBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate interaction-centric human-robot collaboration, addressing the limitations of existing vision-language-action benchmarks that focus on isolated manipulation skills.

title: GPUSimBench: Towards Scalable and Reliable GPU-Accelerated Simulators in Embodied AI
summary: This paper introduces GPUSimBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the scalability and reliability of GPU-accelerated simulators, which are foundational for training data-driven embodied AI systems.

title: A Bayesian framework for the uncanny valley in humanoid robot design
summary: This paper proposes a Bayesian framework to explain the uncanny valley phenomenon in humanoid robot design, which describes how increasing human-likeness in robots can paradoxically reduce human affinity.

title: A 3DGS-Driven Dynamic Viewpoint and Vibrotactile Framework for Subsea Teleoperation Validated via fNIRS
summary: This paper presents a 3DGS-driven dynamic viewpoint and vibrotactile framework for subsea teleoperation, improving the control and perception of remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) in challenging underwater environments.

title: Attitude Estimation Using Inertial and Barometric Measurements
summary: This research addresses the challenge of accurate and robust attitude estimation for autonomous vehicles, especially in GNSS-denied environments, by leveraging inertial and barometric measurements.

title: Adapting Generalist Vehicle Models for High-Speed MPC Across Terrains
summary: This paper explores adapting generalist vehicle models for high-speed Model Predictive Control (MPC) across various terrains, enhancing off-road autonomy through precise closed-loop control.

title: Safe Overtaking for Autonomous Racing Using Hierarchical Optimization and Learning-Based Control
summary: This research proposes a method for safe overtaking in autonomous racing, combining hierarchical optimization and learning-based control using Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to balance performance and safety.

title: WNOJ-LIO: A White-Noise-on-Jerk Motion-Prior EKF for High-Dynamic LiDAR-IMU Fusion
summary: This paper introduces WNOJ-LIO, a White-Noise-on-Jerk Motion-Prior Extended Kalman Filter, designed to improve LiDAR-IMU fusion for high-dynamic autonomous navigation by addressing motion distortion and vibration challenges.

title: Ego-Dynamics-Augmented World Model for Autonomous Driving with Zero-Shot Cross-Chassis Adaptation
summary: This research proposes an ego-dynamics-augmented world model for autonomous driving that enables zero-shot cross-chassis adaptation, addressing the limitations of egocentric bird's-eye-view representations in existing driving world models.

title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
summary: This paper presents a method for generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) finetuning for robots, using representation anchoring and language-action alignment to prevent overwriting pretrained VLM representations during behavior cloning.

title: Learning Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics for Deformable Object Simulation
summary: This research proposes Physics-Guided Residual Dynamics (PGRD), a hybrid simulation framework that combines physics-based and learning approaches to accurately simulate deformable objects for robotic manipulation applications.

title: Joint On-and-Off Policy Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: This paper explores joint on-and-off policy learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), enabling embodied agents to navigate physical environments by following natural language instructions using Vision-Language Models.

title: EgoHTR: Egocentric 4D Demonstrations of Human Terrain Traversal
summary: This research introduces EgoHTR, a dataset of egocentric 4D demonstrations of human terrain traversal, aimed at assisting the deployment of humanoid robots in complex, unstructured environments.

title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
summary: This paper proposes a learned state estimator for autonomous surgical tissue retraction, addressing the challenge of manipulating deformable tissues under partial observability with noisy perceptions.

title: Improving Map Consistency in Graph-Based LiDAR SLAM Through Information-Aware Odometry and Retroactive Loop Closure
summary: This research focuses on improving map consistency in graph-based LiDAR SLAM systems for robotics tasks by using information-aware odometry and retroactive loop closure to ensure geometrically accurate maps.

title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
summary: This paper introduces Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal embedding model designed to help robots understand their body state by integrating various sensory inputs beyond visual data.

title: Flow-aware Optimal Navigation in Unsteady Flows through Reinforcement Learning
summary: This research explores flow-aware optimal navigation for autonomous robots in unsteady fluid flows, using reinforcement learning to overcome challenges of partial observability and unpredictable environments.

title: IMMNet: Hybrid Fusion of Model-based and Data-driven Approaches for Maneuvering Target Tracking
summary: IMMNet is a hybrid model/data-driven algorithm proposed to address challenging maneuvering target tracking in three-dimensional space by integrating model and data-driven approaches.

title: Agile perceptive multi-skill locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
summary: This paper presents APT-RL, a system enabling quadrupedal robots to achieve agile, perceptive, multi-skill locomotion across complex terrains using onboard sensors.

title: Active Trust Management for Successful Human-Robot Teaming: Moving from a Trust Repair to a Trust Satisficing Perspective
summary: This work proposes an active trust management framework for successful human-robot teaming, shifting from trust repair to a trust satisficing perspective for AI-endowed mobile robots.

title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
summary: This research investigates semantic anchoring for robotic action representations in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to prevent degradation during fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations and improve generalization.

title: An Empirical Study on Stage-Information Interfaces for VLA Fine-Tuning
summary: This empirical study explores stage-information interfaces for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning in long-horizon robotic manipulation, using segmented action annotations and a progress module to guide the action policy.

title: From Language to Navigation Goals: A Vision-Language Approach for Semantic Navigation of Mobile Robots Using RGB-D Perception
summary: This paper proposes a vision-language approach for semantic navigation, enabling mobile robots to transform natural language instructions into executable navigation actions using RGB-D perception.

title: Anatomy of Uncertainty: Expressive Descriptors of Robotic Manipulator Motion for Non-verbal Communication in Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This work introduces a mathematical framework for expressing perceptual uncertainty through robotic manipulator motion to improve non-verbal communication in human-robot collaboration.

title: Towards a Modular Bin-picking Framework for Handling Object Pose Uncertainties
summary: This paper proposes a modular bin-picking framework designed to handle object pose uncertainties, aiming for reliable performance in precise robotic bin-picking applications.

title: nuTruck: Benchmarking Autonomous Driving Planning for Distributed Electric-drive Trucks
